Hotel prices in the United States: 2,927 hotels across booking sites

185 cities and 2,927 hotels. For each hotel: the price on each booking site we recorded for the same stay, low to high, the going rate, and which site was lowest against it. Prices are per night, from snapshots taken September 25, 2026 to October 10, 2026; each city page names its own snapshot and stay. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

At 2,072 of the 2,927 hotels, a site was 5% or more below the going rate on its page (all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees); the sites lowest there most often: Super.com (498 hotels), Vio.com (334 hotels), Traveluro (249 hotels), Etrip.net (243 hotels). A tie counts for each site.
